resolved_config.construction: Rejection-sample generic validation episodes having a retained bridge whose removal splits the first-block support graph into two components of at least two items. Choose an eligible target uniformly. Move its block-2 observation to the first slot of block 2, preserving slot times. Redundant history includes an identical target observation in block 1; novel history replaces that earlier bridge by another existing relation. Thus the novel target reconnects two previously disconnected groups, whereas the redundant target repeats direct evidence. Current observation, position, prefix length and suffix match. No diagnostic labels enter model inputs.
resolved_config.decision: Dynamic selection supported only when both arms generic competent, cost budget passes, write-fraction interaction lower>0 and remote-influence interaction lower>0; CE benefits and all raw contrasts reported. Otherwise dynamic selectivity unresolved, not automatically static gating. No m-specific mediation claim.
resolved_config.intervention: At target trial only, zero global evidence channels 34 and 37; preserve local evidence, cues, time and suffix. Compare global-only terminal margins, direct and disjoint remote queries.
resolved_config.metrics: Per episode target sum effective writes, target/episode write fraction, mean total support write, global direct and remote absolute margin change, global CE increase on target removal. Average within each network with episode-paired bootstrap. Primary interaction (novel-redundant) cost minus shared in target write fraction; secondary interaction in remote influence and CE benefit.
resolved_config.question: Cost-vs-shared interaction in useful-vs-redundant current-evidence allocation and global causal influence.
resolved_config.scope: Non-Liu bridge-enriched diagnostic, distinct from generic coefficient development and competence sets; identical for all six models. It does not estimate all-task selectivity or m-specific mediation.
